brief.zh: 一个 issue，两处容易写错的修改，在两个文件里。
brief.en: One issue, two easy-to-get-wrong changes, in two files.

t.zh: 和<level-ref to="2-3"></level-ref>一样的机器，多一层：要转更多轮，测试报告里一次失败两处。
t.en: The same machine as <level-ref to="2-3"></level-ref>, one level deeper: more turns, and a report that fails two changes at once.

after.zh: 一份报告列出所有失败，模型每一轮修它看得到的那些。轮数多了，历史也跟着变长。
after.en: One report lists every failure, and each turn the model fixes the ones it can see. More turns, and a longer history.
